recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed for FHIR-16776; future questionnaire expression execution guidance should be handled in SDC or extension-pack cqf-expression guidance, not by restoring the retired core PHQ-9/CQIF Questionnaire example.
issue_request: FHIR-16776 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification STU3 CDS change request for Clinical Reasoning module section 14.3.0.7. It asked when the PHQ-9 Questionnaire fragment's cqif-cqlExpression/CalculateTotalScore expression was executed, with a resolution to update the example based on SDC alignment efforts.
initial_application: The Jira comment cites SVN 14073; corresponding git-svn commit 3dc81b908557be64248363dc4e5bbf5ed5213965 mentions GF#16776/GF#16780 and changed ActivityDefinition and PlanDefinition dynamicValue elements and examples to use the Expression datatype, but did not alter the PHQ-9 Documentation Template fragment itself. Later commit 7fb13bf1654f19e63d117420b4bcdf0deb69888c converted that fragment from cqlExpression wording to cqf-expression/valueExpression while leaving the example in place.
additional_context: Later Published CDS decisions FHIR-21005 and FHIR-30204 withdrew CQIF/CQF Questionnaire and directed questionnaire calculation/population guidance to SDC. Commit bc30255627a58b5e899f1afd7a087806ab48ac23 removed the CQF Questionnaire/PHQ-9 fragment from source/clinicalreasoning-knowledge-artifact-representation.html and replaced it with an SDC reference. Current core source no longer contains CalculateTotalScore or cqif-cqlExpression outside historical release files; the extension-pack cqf-expression definition also points questionnaire users to SDC guidance.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because the current Clinical Reasoning source has removed the ambiguous example that prompted the question and delegates questionnaire dynamic behavior guidance to SDC.
